summary.text: Scott E. Hutchinson is a Republican who was re-elected in November 2024 to his fourth term representing Pennsylvania's 21st Senatorial District (Clarion, Forest, Venango and Warren Counties and parts of Butler and Erie Counties); he chairs the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hutchinson was born in Oil City in 1961, graduated from Oil City Area High School, and earned a B.S. in economics from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania in 1983.
He was chief deputy county treasurer for Venango County from 1984 to 1992 and served on the Oil City Area School Board from 1985 to 1992.
He represented the 64th Legislative District in the state House from 1992 to 2012.

In the Senate he is vice chairman of the Environmental Resources and Energy Committee, chairs the Local Government Commission, and was prime sponsor of Act 52 of 2016, which established the Pennsylvania Grade Crude Development Advisory Council.
He is married to the former Mary Beth Radkowski; they have three children and live in Oil City.
